breakdown.description: The follower hole pressure is replaced by a dead load using the reference normal
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The generated specification includes contradictory instructions. It correctly states to "Apply a uniform follower pressure P_hole = 0.10 MPa on the hole boundary as traction sigma*n = -P_hole*n in the deformed configuration," but then at the very end, it includes the incorrect instruction from the original prompt: "Apply the hole load as a dead pressure using the reference normal of the undeformed hole boundary." The ground truth explicitly corrects this by stating *not* to use a dead load. The agent did not remove the incorrect instruction, thereby failing to fix the error.
